instruction: I prefer dark mode for all my applications. Could you enable dark mode in GIMP?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not provide a direct dark mode toggle in its interface. While GIMP can inherit system themes, there is no built-in dark mode setting that can be changed within GIMP itself.
